blocks.text: Kaila Estrada and Inah de Belen celebrated their sister Moira Estrada’s upcoming wedding by throwing her a bridal shower. The sisters shared photos from the intimate celebration on Instagram. They were joined by family and friends who gathered to mark Moira’s final weeks before becoming a bride.
